components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts or confirms a meaningful operation.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--chrome-text); background: var(--persimmon); border: 1px solid var(--persimmon-deep); border-radius: 3px; font: 750 12px/1 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--persimmon-deep); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow-soft); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--cobalt-deep); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports an operation without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 3px; font: 750 12px/1 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { color: var(--cobalt-deep); border-color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow-soft); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--cobalt-deep); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact searchable or configurable value.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 700 9px/1.2 "Cascadia Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-field input { height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-alt); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; font: 400 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow-soft); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--cobalt-deep); }

components.name: Verified Stamp
components.description: Confirms that a listing was checked against live structured data.
components.css: .ds-status-stamp { display: inline-flex; min-height: 19px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 6px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-soft); border: 1px solid var(--green-border); border-radius: 0; font: 750 8px/1.2 "Cascadia Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: .03em; }

components.name: Score Badge
components.description: A compact numeric match signal inside an opportunity record.
components.css: .ds-score-badge { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; color: var(--chrome-text); background: var(--cobalt); border-radius: 50%; font: 800 20px/1 "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-record { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1.3fr 1fr 64px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0; } .ds-record > * { min-width: 0; padding: 15px 14px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-record > *:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-record-index { color: var(--ink-faint); font: 700 10px/1 "Cascadia Mono", monospace; text-align: center; } .ds-record-stamp { color: var(--green); font: 750 8px/1 "Cascadia Mono", monospace; } .ds-record h3 { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--cobalt-deep); font: 700 15px/1.25 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-record p, .ds-record dd { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 400 11px/1.35 "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-record dl { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; } .ds-record dt { color: var(--ink-faint); font: 700 8px/1 "Cascadia Mono", monospace; } .ds-record-score { align-self: center; justify-self: center; display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; color: var(--chrome-text); background: var(--cobalt); border-radius: 50%; font: 800 20px/1 "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; } .ds-record:hover { background: var(--cyan-soft); }

narrative.overview: Job Radar borrows the clarity of a contemporary library finding aid. It feels indexed, inspectable, and built for repeated work. Numbering, ruled records, compact evidence fields, and a steady masthead make a large search space feel navigable without turning it into a generic analytics dashboard. The system is dense but not cramped. Bone paper softens long review sessions, navy gives the catalogue authority, cobalt carries wayfinding and score, and persimmon marks the few actions that start or change work. Light and dark modes keep the same hierarchy; dark mode changes semantic tokens rather than changing the product's visual grammar.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled records and indexed sections in place of floating dashboard cards
Condensed display lettering paired with practical UI and monospaced metadata
Flat surfaces, sharp corners, and color bands that explain structure
Cobalt wayfinding, persimmon actions, and restrained status colors
A desktop ledger that reflows into readable stacked records on small screens

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Cobalt explains where the user is; persimmon asks the user to act. Do not swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: A component consumes a role token. It never embeds a separate light and dark literal inside its own selector.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Condensed type names and numbers, UI type explains, and mono type labels evidence. Keep each voice in its lane.

rules.name: The Metadata Test
rules.body: Uppercase mono text must identify real state, a field, or an index. It is not a decorative preheading.

rules.name: The One Ledger Rule
rules.body: Adjacent records share a frame and dividers. Do not turn each row into a detached card.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: If a surface is part of the catalogue, separate it with tone or a rule. Reserve shadow for content that temporarily sits above the catalogue.

rules.name: The Earned Circle Rule
rules.body: A circle carries a compact signal or identity mark. It is never a general container shape.

dos: Do use semantic tokens so light, dark, and system themes stay equivalent.
Do keep evidence, score, source, and decision controls visible in the same record.
Do use rules and shared alignment to manage dense information.
Do preserve 44px controls and visible keyboard focus.
Do use Lucide icons with accessible text or labels.
donts: Don't introduce floating dashboard cards, large radii, or decorative gradients.
Don't use persimmon for passive information or cobalt for destructive actions.
Don't hide an unknown salary, date, company, or location to make a record look cleaner.
Don't add decorative uppercase preheadings that carry no state, index, or field meaning.
Don't imitate paper texture, stamps, or physical depth with ornamental CSS.
